title: Editor configuration file
description: A schema file that describes the config.json used for initializing the Editor application.

version.title: File version
version.description: The version of the layout of this configuration file. If this value is not provided, the file is assumed to be of version 1

applicationPath.title: Applications folder
applicationPath.description: The path to the folder where the application JSON files are located

clusterPath.title: Clusters folder
clusterPath.description: The path to the folder where the cluster JSON files are located

nodePath.title: Nodes folder
nodePath.description: The path to the folder where the node JSON files are located
